description: A mid-century modern wood tripod floor lamp with an integrated shelf and a flaxen linen shade. It uses an E26 bulb base (bulb not included) and features an on/off foot switch, ideal for living rooms, bedrooms, or offices.

white-crown-dimmable-charging-sensitive.text:
name: white-crown-Dimmable-Charging-Sensitive
description: LED desk lamp for reading, studying, and work featuring 52 eye-friendly LEDs, 5 lighting modes and 5 brightness levels, touch controls with memory, and a built-in 5V/1A USB charging port. It includes 30/60-minute auto-off timer, eye-caring light with no UV/IR, and a durable aluminum design rated up to 50,000 hours.
